qtypes.label: Multiple choice
qtypes.description: One correct answer from four options (A-D).

qtypes.label: State / identify
qtypes.description: Give one fact, example or feature; no development needed.

qtypes.label: Define / What is meant by
qtypes.description: Precise definition of a key term (1 mark Define, 2 marks What is meant by).

qtypes.label: Describe
qtypes.description: One point plus one linked development.

qtypes.label: Calculate
qtypes.description: Numerical answer with working and correct units.

qtypes.label: Draw / label a diagram
qtypes.description: Draw a shift or curve on the axes given, or label a diagram.

qtypes.label: Explain
qtypes.description: Identify, develop and apply one reason, effect or advantage to the context.

qtypes.label: Analyse (6 marks)
qtypes.description: One-sided developed chains of reasoning using the data; levels marked AO2/AO3.

qtypes.label: Assess (9 marks)
qtypes.description: Analysis plus counter-argument; levels marked AO2/AO3/AO4.

qtypes.label: Evaluate (12 marks)
qtypes.description: Balanced argument with a supported judgement; levels marked AO2/AO3/AO4.

qtypes.label: Data response (Question 4 style)
qtypes.description: Data table and extract with a calculation, a 6-mark analyse and a 12-mark evaluate.
